question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India mentions 'Continuance of the rights of citizenship'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 10.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 10**__

 __
 
• **Continuance of citizenship rights** Any person who, pursuant to any of the foregoing provisions of this Part, is or is deemed to be a citizen of India shall continue to be such a citizen, subject to the provisions of any legislation that may be made by Parliament.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 9**:__ Persons voluntarily acquiring citizenship of foreign state not to be citizens. 
 
• __**Article 12**__: Article 12 defines the State includes the Government and Parliament of India and the Government and the Legislature of each of the States and all local or other authorities within the territory of India or under the control of the Government of India.
 
• __**Article 11**__: Parliament to regulate the rights of citizenship by law. Everyone has the right to freedom of peace assembly and to freedom of association others, including the right to form and to j trade unions for the protection of his interests.
